latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of hevycli skill — command-line access and analysis for Hevy fitness data.

- View and export workout history, details, and totals with filters and JSON output.
- List and inspect workout routines and exercise templates.
- Analyze user fitness progress over time (volume, patterns, frequency).
- Supports short IDs, pagination (max 10/page), and debug mode.
- Requires Hevy Pro and API key configuration.
- Data is read-only; outputs support table and JSON formats.
